      obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := ih
      refine ⟨q * Polynomial.X ^ 3 + (Polynomial.X - 1), ?_⟩
      calc
        Polynomial.X ^ (3 * (k + 1)) - 1 =
            (Polynomial.X ^ (3 * k) - 1) * Polynomial.X ^ 3 +
              (Polynomial.X ^ 3 - 1) := by
